decisions.reason: It has had its own product page for two consecutive years, which suggests it fits the firm's core manufacturing offering and is unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
As a newly launched product with a dedicated page, it appears strategically important, though its short market history still leaves some risk if demand disappoints.
Because it was only mentioned rather than fully featured on the website, commitment looks weaker, but as a fresh 2024 launch it would usually be given more time before being discontinued.
